spec_basis (v02.221 module 14).STU-FX-001: "A filter or effect applied to any `StudioLayer` is recorded as a `StudioLiveFilter` node inside that layer's `StudioEffectStack` ..., never as a destructive pixel/geometry mutation of the layer's source data."
spec_basis (v02.221 module 14).STU-FX-002: "A `StudioEffectStack` is an ordered list of `StudioLiveFilter` entries. Each entry carries: `filter_kind` ..., typed parameter payload, an optional `StudioMask` reference ..., a `StudioBlendMode` + opacity ..., an `enabled` flag, and an `render_scope` (`layer` | `below` | `group`)"
spec_basis (v02.221 module 14).STU-FX-003: "Every stack entry is re-editable, reorderable, maskable, and individually enable/disable-able ... Reordering two entries re-composes the stack in the new order deterministically."
spec_basis (v02.221 module 14).STU-FX-008: "Each stack entry composes onto the accumulated result using its `StudioBlendMode` + opacity, exactly as a layer blends"
spec_basis (v02.221 module 14).STU-FX-011: "Effect evaluation is deterministic: given the same source data, parameters, mask, seed, and `StudioColorProfile`, the `RenderEngine` MUST produce byte-stable output for a given backend"
spec_basis (v02.221 module 14).STU-FX-011b: "an effect parameter exposed to motion is the same typed field, sampled per frame, and the effect re-evaluates deterministically per timeline sample"
spec_basis (v02.221 module 14).STU-FX-104: "A value outside `[hard_min, hard_max]` is an ERROR, not a clamp: the typed command surface MUST reject it with a determinate `EFFECT_PARAM_OUT_OF_RANGE` result"
spec_basis (v02.221 module 14).STU-FX-105: soft bounds "are NOT a validation surface. An operator or a model MAY set a value outside the soft range and inside the hard range; doing so is legal"
spec_basis (v02.221 module 14).STU-FX-106/107: bound_state enumeration; "Collapsing hard and soft bounds into one range is FORBIDDEN"
spec_basis (v02.221 module 14).STU-FX-112: kinds incl. `angle` "wraps rather than clamps unless a hard bound is declared", `point_2d` "stored as fractions of layer size by default", `enumeration` "1-based index into `options`"
spec_basis (v02.221 module 14).STU-FX-130/131: Distort catalogue rows Twirl (ADBE Twirl, 4 typed params), Spherize (ADBE Spherize, 3), Offset (ADBE Offset, 3), Polar Coordinates (ADBE Polar Coordinates, 3); Generate rows Gradient Ramp (ADBE Ramp, 9), Circle (ADBE Circle, 13), Checkerboard (ADBE Checkerboard, 13); their 14.9.4 parameter tables reproduced row for row
spec_basis (v02.221 module 14).STU-CMP-010: "3. **Effects.** Evaluate the `StudioEffectStack` in stack order ([STU-FX-002]). Effects therefore see MASKED content"; STU-CMP-010b "masks are applied BEFORE effects, and the transform is applied AFTER effects"
